name: Resurface.exe
source:
The narrative begins at a spring in northeastern Italy. As you step back into a place haunted by memory and remorse, a voice rises from the water – one that knows you too well, and too deeply.

[From [url=https://jecopx.itch.io/resurface]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事开始于意大利东北部的一个春天。当你回到一个充满记忆和悔恨的地方时，一个声音从水中升起——一个太了解你、太了解你的声音。

[来自[url=https://jecopx.itch.io/resurface]Itch.io[/url]]
